whoItsFor: Developers and ML practitioners who want to know which open-source LLMs their hardware can comfortably run locally, before downloading anything.
useCases: Pick a local model that fits your system's RAM and GPU VRAM before downloading it
Compare models across fit, speed, quality, and context on your own machine
Feed recommendations into scripts, agents, or dashboards via `llmfit recommend --json` or the REST API

requirements.os: macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), Linux (x86_64 & ARM64), Windows (x86_64)
requirements.runtime: Rust toolchain (cargo) for building from source
